title: 2,200-year-old Roman shipwreck reveals an ingenious waterproofing trick
caption:
How did a 2,200-year-old Roman ship stay afloat? Researchers found two distinct waterproofing recipes, but the real discovery was the microscopic pollen trapped in the tar, which revealed the ship's repair history.

Source: Sciencedaily - 2,200-year-old Roman shipwreck reveals an ingenious waterproofing trick
